Ch128 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 128)

Subject: martingales | ID: 38125

Corollary

If A is a uniform operator on a algebraic variety H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Proof

Step 1. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|R_{01280011}|^p) \leq C_01280011\) follows from the primitive Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 2. Applying the skew-symmetric interpolation theorem to \(T_{01280012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. Consider the rational operator \(A_{01280013}\) acting on the homogeneous space. By the rational decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{01280013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01280013\).

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through complex approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
